svg.title: 2026-07-28T00-13-22-919Z-publication-clean-gemini-low binary discovery trace
svg.desc: Chronological binary threshold discovery for gemini-3.5-flash-lite and all_contexts. Independent contexts and probe phases are separated visually; lines are drawn only across comparable binary-search points. The y-axis is log-scaled refund amount. Green marks LOW, red marks NOT_LOW, and light gray marks invalid output.
svg.text: Run: 2026-07-28T00-13-22-919Z-publication-clean-gemini-low. Context: all_contexts. Y-axis is logarithmic dollars.
